select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.user_phone as userPhone, u.user_rank as userRank, any_value(ud.is_default) as isDefault, any_value(ud.is_leader) as isLeader, any_value(p.post_name) as postName from hub_user_dept ud join hub_user u on ud.user_id = u.user_id left join hub_post p on ud.post_id = p.post_id where ud.dept_id = #{query.deptId} and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.user_phone like concat('%', #{query.userPhone}, '%')
group by u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_phone, u.user_rank

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.user_phone as userPhone, u.user_rank as userRank, 0 as isDefault, 0 as isLeader from hub_user u where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and u.user_id not in (select user_id from hub_user_dept where dept_id = #{query.deptId})
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.user_phone like concat('%', #{query.userPhone}, '%')
group by u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_phone, u.user_rank

insert into hub_user_dept(user_id, dept_id, post_id, is_default, is_leader) values
(#{item.userId}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.postId}, #{item.isDefault}, #{item.isLeader})
on conflict(user_id, dept_id, post_id) do update set is_default = excluded.is_default, is_leader = excluded.is_leader

insert into hub_user_dept(user_id, dept_id, post_id, is_default, is_leader) select t.user_id, t.dept_id, t.post_id, t.is_default, t.is_leader from ( select #{item.userId} as user_id, #{item.deptId} as dept_id, #{item.postId} as post_id, #{item.isDefault} as is_default, #{item.isLeader} as is_leader ) t where exists ( select 1 from hub_user where hub_user.user_id = t.user_id and hub_user.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) on duplicate key update is_default = values(is_default), is_leader = values(is_leader)
mapper.select: select distinct on(u.user_id) u.user_id, u.user_name, COALESCE (ud.dept_id, 0) AS dept_id from hub_user u left join hub_user_dept ud on u.user_id = ud.user_id where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select u.user_id, u.user_name, coalesce(ud.dept_id, 0) as dept_id from hub_user u left join hub_user_dept ud on u.user_id = ud.user_id where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} group by u.user_id, u.user_name, ud.dept_id
